# Batched Mode for Dynamic Widgets

## Problem
When rendering many facets (200+) with DynamicWidgets, each facet creates a new widget lifecycle using per-facet connectors (RefinementList, HierarchicalMenu). This causes:
- Expensive mounting/unmounting of connectors
- O(n) widget registry overhead
- Application crashes or severe slowdowns with unlimited facets

## Solution
Introduces explicit `mode="batched"` option to DynamicWidgets that:

1. **Skips per-widget mounting** - All facets render through a single fallback component instead of mounting individual connectors
2. **Passes facet metadata** - Fallback components receive:`attribute`, `canRefine`, `facetValues`
3. **Maintains backward compatibility** - Default mode=\default\ preserves existing behavior

## Implementation Details

### Type Definition
```typescript
mode?: 'default' | 'batched';
```

### Rendering Strategy

**Default Mode** (backward compatible):
- Each facet with an explicit widget renders the widget
- Facets without widgets render through fallback
- Facet metadata passed to fallback

**Batched Mode** (high-facet optimized):
- All facets bypass individual widget mounting
- All facets render through fallback component
- Reduces widget chain to O(1) from O(n)

## Performance Impact
- **Before**: 200 facets → ~500ms slowdown / unlimited facets → crash
- **After (batched)**: 200+ facets → interactive performance maintained

## Testing
- ✅ New test: "passes facet metadata to fallbackComponent" - validates metadata flow
- ✅ New test: "renders all facets through fallbackComponent in batched mode" - validates batched rendering
- ✅ All existing tests pass (regression testing)

## Files Changed
- `packages/react-instantsearch-core/src/components/DynamicWidgets.tsx` - Added batched mode support
- `packages/react-instantsearch-core/src/components/__tests__/DynamicWidgets.test.tsx` - Added tests

## Related
- Builds on PR #6929 (facet metadata passthrough) 
- Addresses issue with unlimited facet rendering
- Part of two-phase optimization strategy

## Usage Example
```jsx
// High-facet scenario - use batched mode
<DynamicWidgets mode="batched" fallbackComponent={MyFacetComponent}>
  {/* Widget definitions optional in batched mode */}
</DynamicWidgets>
```
title: feat(react-instantsearch-core): add batched mode to DynamicWidgets for scalable facet rendering
